title: Associated Terms Of British Revenue System
definition: The specialized vernacular and administrative terminology associated with the three major British land revenue settlements (Permanent Settlement, Ryotwari, and Mahalwari) implemented in colonial India to maximize agrarian surplus extraction.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (matching terms with meanings or matching terms to regions/systems) and Mains (GS-1 Modern Indian History: Land revenue impacts, peasant movements, and rural impoverishment).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational vernacular and administrative terms of the British revenue apparatus.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions of colonial land extraction.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims match-the-column questions.
prerequisites: Basic chronology of British conquest of India
Understanding of Permanent Settlement, Ryotwari, and Mahalwari systems
